insights: State Contractor Registration: Rhode Island requires contractor registration Rhode Island Contractors Registration Board requires registration—verify at crb.ri.gov. Registration provides consumer protection.
Coastal Flood Risk: Rhode Island coastline faces significant flood risk Coastal flooding from storms is common. FEMA flood zones affect insurance and construction requirements.
Hurricane Risk: Rhode Island faces hurricane impacts Hurricanes occasionally affect RI. Reddit recommends hurricane straps and wind-resistant features.
High Construction Costs: Rhode Island has above-average construction costs Labor costs are higher than national average. Reddit warns that very low bids usually indicate problems.
